title: atomate2 VASP static calculation
description:
This workflow declaration defines the httk atomate2-static workflow: it runs atomate2's StaticMaker, one VASP single-point calculation of a structure. The protocol, the VASP input set and the custodian error handling are those of atomate2's StaticMaker.
It defines the meaning of its roles: input role initial_structure is a structures entry containing the structure to evaluate.
Output role total_energy is a records entry containing the total energy of the structure: the final ionic step's energy(sigma->0), in eV, output role band_gap is a records entry containing the band gap of the structure, in eV, and output role task_document is a files entry containing jobflow-outputs.json: the final atomate2 task document (an emmet TaskDoc) as JSON.

outputs.name: total_energy
outputs.description: The total energy of the structure: the final ionic step's energy(sigma->0), in eV.

outputs.name: band_gap
outputs.description: The band gap of the structure, in eV.

outputs.name: task_document
outputs.description: jobflow-outputs.json: the final atomate2 task document (an emmet TaskDoc) as JSON.
